note: Which brawlers have buffies available. The official API does not say, so this list is kept by hand: add a brawler's name (exactly as it appears in catalog.json, upper-case) when Supercell releases buffies for them - roughly 6 brawlers per season. Seeded from a third-party count of 27 brawlers and cross-checked against this account's own data (every brawler with an owned buffie is on the list). The dashboard also treats any brawler it sees with an owned buffie as buffie-enabled, so a stale list can only under-count unowned ones.
